reading.title: Policy Analysis and Fiscal Impact Statement CR-036-2023, Payment in Lieu of Taxes (“PILOT”) – Agreement for the Hamlet Woods Apartments

candidates.quote: Revenues: Forgone tax revenues totaling approximately $ 1,436,110 over a 30-year period.

The Hamlet Woods Project (“Project”) is located at the end of 57th Avenue in Bladensburg Prince George’s County, Maryland, and is a 59-unit townhouse-style affordable housing project that consists of 5 sticks of townhouse -style buildings.

Under the proposed agreement, for the 30-year term, Osprey Property Company II LLC and Parallax Development Group, LLC (“Owner”) will have a target population of families whose incomes are at or below 80% of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).

Under the proposed agreement, for the 30-year term, Osprey Property Company II LLC and Parallax Development Group, LLC (“Owner”) will have a target population of families whose incomes are at or below 80% of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).
candidates.wording: at or below 80% of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The Owner will also reserve 3 units to meet the Uniform Federal Accessibility Standards (UFAS) requirements, and 2 units will be built to accommodate residents with sensory impairments.
candidates.value: 3 UFAS units and 2 sensory impairment units

candidates.quote: CR-036-2023 would authorize the County to accept a payment in lieu of taxes equal to a $600.00 payment per affordable unit during the term of the PILOT agreement.
Adoption of CR-036-2023 will have an adverse fiscal impact in the form of forgone tax revenue.
candidates.wording: will have an adverse fiscal impact in the form of forgone tax revenue

candidates.quote: As described above, accepting the PILOT on the entire Project of $35,400 will result in a loss of approximately $35,400 in the first year of the term.
candidates.wording: accepting the PILOT on the entire Project

candidates.quote: Factoring in the 2% estimated average annual increase in the property tax assessment, the total impact is estimated at $1,436,110.00 over the 30- year period that the PILOT agreement remains in effect.
candidates.wording: total impact is estimated at $1,436,110.00 over the 30- year period

candidates.quote: However, should CR -036-2023 not be adopted the Owner may raise rents, mak ing the units unaffordable to tenants at 80% AMI.

• The Agreement provides that “Eligible Households” are those earning 80% or less of AMI on page 1 of Attachment B, but in the definition of “Eligible Household on page 4, 60% of AMI is the reference.
candidates.wording: those earning 80% or less of AMI
candidates.value: 80% or less of AMI and 60% of AMI
